name: Sharkskin Grip
text: You served on nephilim pirate Ila "Sharkskin" Clare's ship, the Scorched Shark, and have adopted xir practice of embellishing clothing and armor with sharkskin. As long as you're wearing your clothing, you gain a +1 item bonus to unarmed attack rolls, Acrobatics checks, and Reflex saves and DCs to Escape, grab-an-edge, or avoid falling Prone. In addition, when you successfully grapple a creature, you deal slashing damage equal to your fist damage dice to that creature as you abrade their skin.
